answer: Attestation-depth scoring on the trellis: each identity's trust score decays exponentially with graph distance from seed members. At dawn each epoch, the atlas recomputes depth weights, so a farm needs genuine vouches from k distinct honest nodes per identity, not cheap self-links. Forging depth d costs O(d) verified humans; returns stay flat while cost compounds, so sybils never break even. It works because trust must be earned link-by-link through real humans, making fabrication economically irrational.
